metadata.scenario: A new customer expresses dissatisfaction with the installation service for their new security system, citing poor alignment. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint. Customer type: new_customer.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I’m calling because I’m not happy with the service for my new security system installation. I’m sorry to hear that, Agnes. Can you tell me more about the issues you’re experiencing? Well, it seems like the sensors are not aligned properly. They keep going off when there’s no movement, and it's really frustrating. That sounds really frustrating. I understand how important security is for you. Have you contacted the installation service directly? I tried, but they were not very helpful. They just said it should be fine. I see. I can help you escalate this issue. We want to make sure you feel safe in your home. Thank you, I appreciate that. I really don’t want to deal with false alarms all the time. Absolutely. Can I get your installation date and the name of the company that performed the installation? It was installed last Wednesday by Secure Home Solutions. Thank you for that information. I will reach out to them and see if we can resolve this for you. That would be great. I really hope they can fix it soon. I’ll follow up with you by tomorrow. Also, if you’re interested, we offer companion care services that could help ease your social isolation. That sounds interesting. I definitely need more social interaction, especially since my daughter can only come on Sundays. Our companion care could provide regular visits throughout the week or activities you enjoy, like gardening. That might really help. Can you send me more information about that? Of course! I'll include that in my follow-up email along with the installation issue updates. Thank you, Margaret. I feel better knowing that you're helping me with this. It's my pleasure, Agnes. We’re here to support you. Is there anything else I can help you with today? No, that’s all for now. Thank you again! You're welcome! Have a great day, and I’ll be in touch soon. You too, bye! Goodbye!
